_about: Standard Ontario detached residential build sequence as a task network for critical-path scheduling. Each task has an id, a human label, a list of predecessor ids (tasks that must finish first), and a duration_model. Durations are ENGINEERING ESTIMATES derived from work quantities and crew productivity, not schedule commitments. They ignore weather, trade availability, permit/inspection queue times, supply lead times and change orders. Treat the computed schedule as a planning aid and confirm every date against real trade calendars, the municipal inspection queue and the Ontario Building Code.

_reference_project.description: All 'derived' quantities below are sized for ONE reference house. Change these to match your project, or override the quantity on any task, and re-run schedule.py.
_reference_project.note: Areas/lengths are round planning figures for a mid-size Ontario home. TUNE them.

_duration_model.fixed: duration_days = days. Used for administrative waits, concrete cure and inspections, where calendar time is not driven by a crew's output.
_duration_model.derived: duration_days = ceil(quantity / (crew * productivity)), minimum 1. crew = number of workers (or machine-operator units). productivity = units of work one worker completes per working day. daily_output = crew * productivity. ALL crew sizes and productivity rates below are ASSUMPTIONS and are marked tunable:true — they are typical small-builder figures, NOT measured from your crews. Replace them with your own history for a real schedule.
_duration_model.units: Working days (Mon-Fri). Weekends and holidays are skipped only when --start-date is given to print calendar dates.

duration_model.note: Municipal review/issuance wait, not crew work. Ontario municipalities vary widely (statutory targets ~10 business days for a house, often longer in practice). Set to your municipality's real turnaround.

duration_model.productivity_unit: cu yd per machine-crew per day
duration_model.note: One excavator + operator. Volume = basement dig plus over-dig for a ~1000 sqft footprint at ~8 ft depth.

duration_model.productivity_unit: lin ft formed+poured per worker per day
lin ft of wall formed+poured per worker per day
duration_model.note: Cast-in-place; adjust productivity down for ICF or block.
Wait for concrete to gain strength before stripping forms and backfilling. Cold Ontario weather lengthens this; not crew-driven.

duration_model.productivity_unit: cu yd per machine-crew per day
duration_model.note: Damp-proofing, weeping tile and drainage layer assumed done just before backfill; fold into this task or add your own.

lin ft of wall framed+stood per worker per day
sqft of roof framed per worker per day
duration_model.note: Engineered trusses set by crane are faster; stick-framing is slower.

squares per worker per day (incl. underlayment/flashing)
duration_model.note: 1 square = 100 sqft. Runs in parallel with windows/doors.

duration_model.productivity_unit: sqft roughed per worker per day
duration_model.note: Weathertight shell required first. Runs in parallel with plumbing + HVAC rough-ins.

duration_model.productivity_unit: sqft roughed per worker per day
duration_model.note: Runs in parallel with electrical + HVAC rough-ins; usually the slowest of the three, so it tends to drive the rough-in window.

duration_model.productivity_unit: sqft roughed per worker per day
duration_model.note: Runs in parallel with electrical + plumbing rough-ins.
Municipal inspection before anything is covered. The BOOKING queue can add days/weeks and is NOT modelled here.

duration_model.productivity_unit: sqft of insulated assembly per worker per day
duration_model.note: Exterior wall + ceiling area. Confirm R-values against OBC SB-12.

duration_model.productivity_unit: sqft hung+taped+sanded per worker per day (blended)
duration_model.note: Blended rate deliberately low: it absorbs inter-coat drying time for tape/mud. Board area = walls (both sides) + ceilings.

tasks.label: Interior finishes (trim, paint, floors, cabinets, fixtures)

duration_model.productivity_unit: sqft brought to finish per worker per day (blended trades)
duration_model.note: Coarse blended rate across many trades (paint, flooring, trim, cabinets, plumbing/electrical finish). The single biggest and most variable phase; break it into sub-tasks for a real schedule.
Occupancy inspection. Booking queue not modelled.
